reviews.review:
First off I want to start by saying I love this game. It's an absolute blast to play with friends and solo. I could not recommend this game more. 

Here is where I hope they focus, taken with a grain of salt as I have no idea how difficult these tasks would be. 

I think if I was in charge of this game, I would focus on a few things right away in this order:

More characters
Difficulty settings
Character specific juice unlocks
More challenges
New maps/ a More difficult series of maps

What an awesome game!

The game does have potential, but the balancing is honestly horrible right now.

The first area feels decent—chests are affordable, progression feels okay, and the game is actually fun. But once you hit the second area, everything falls apart. Chest prices jump to an egregious level. You can open 15+ chests in the first area, then suddenly you’re struggling to afford five, even while heavily min-maxing gold. Gold gain simply does not scale properly, and shrines don’t compensate nearly enough for how tanky the enemies become.

Enemy balance is another huge issue. Enemies are way too tanky, melee feels awful to play, and fights drag on far longer than they should. Boss design is especially bad—having a 4-second dodge cooldown against bosses that can hit 6 times in 2 seconds is just terrible game design.

Then there’s progression. Soul Juice is laughably slow: you can play a full run and earn maybe 20–40 Soul Juice, which translates to a 1% damage upgrade. That feels awful. Permanent upgrades take way too long to unlock, making runs feel unrewarding and grindy instead of motivating.

Co-op scaling is also broken. I’m playing with three people, yet the game feels like it’s balanced for six to eight players. Enemy health, damage, and pacing are completely out of sync with the actual party size.

Overall, the scaling from one area to the next is way too extreme and not fun to deal with. Even when playing optimally, the second area feels punishing rather than challenging. The game has the foundation to be good, but in its current state it’s extremely unbalanced.

I had some fun, but with how slow progression is, how expensive chests become, and how poorly enemies scale, I can’t recommend this game right now.

let me preface this by saying I like this game a lot and it is pretty fun. That being said there are some glaring issues.

1.) Melee Player Experience: Melee is really bad and useless. Most enemies have a ton of health and take a long time to kill. Enemies at level 2 and onward all have 1) stun on hitting them, 2) Area of effect Damage over time like burns and poison, 3) Rooting or trapping that destroys movement. Melee has no answer to any of these and gets killed the second any of those three events occur.

The ranged characters just dont do enough damage to justify their low health.

2.) Weapon and power upgrades: It is way too difficult to get better weapons. Most runs I have to use the starting weapon because weapon drops that are better are just too rare. 

3.) Map Size: the map is too spread out and there is not enough time in each stage to effectively traverse and gain enough power. Combine that with the high health of most enemies, it makes it extremely difficult to get to a point where you can beat the boss.

4.) The solo experience: Boss health does not scale with cooperative play. In solo it can take 10-15 minutes to work around the boss patterns and kill the boss. In multiplayer, the boss can die within 5-10 minutes. This makes the solo experience far worse than the multiplayer one, and that is a huge problem.

I think the game is good for some fun, but needs a ton of balance tweaks to be consistently enjoyable. That being said, I hope the game gets better so I can change this review.

The only thing that seemed cool was you'd find new weapons with different abilities on them, while still keeping a few abilities that belong to your specific character's base kit. This would be fun to find synergies with if executed right, but overall the combat was uninspired.

reviews.developer_response: Thanks for the review. There's no pump and dump here. We are going to keep working on LORT and improving it to get to a 1.0 release. As for the roadmap, we updated it based on what we have done so far, and what the next update will be: a new character, new quests, new weapons, and more. We try not to give specifics on further out updates as those plans will be adjusted based on what we get done/what the reception is for the upcoming Q2 update.
